---
title: "Keyboard shortcuts"
---

## General shortcuts

These shortcuts provide quick access to common window, plot-navigation and event-editing actions.

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| **Esc** | Closes any open window except the main window. |
| **U** | Undoes the zoom. |
| **Z** | Pans the graph one window to the left (useful when zoomed in). |
| **X** | Pans the graph one window to the right (useful when zoomed in). |
| **A** or **S** | Hold while clicking the plot zoom buttons for axis-specific zooming (**A**: x-axis, **S**: y-axis). |
| **D** | In *Events* mode, hold while selecting a region on the plot to delete multiple events at once. |

## Events-specific shortcuts

In the *Events* [Analysis]{.ui-label} or [Refine Events]{.ui-label} windows, keyboard shortcuts are available for navigating to and deleting detected events:

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| **Right arrow** | Scrolls to the next event. |
| **Left arrow** | Scrolls to the previous event. |
| **Up arrow** | Moves the main plot to center the selected event. |
| **Space** | Deletes the selected event from the analysis. |
